bank_roles.1: 25 MHz TCXO + Raspberry Pi HAT+ SPI/UART/PPS host interface

uart.primary_use: DCF77 date/time telemetry FPGA to Raspberry Pi

id_eeprom.pad_identity: audited in hardware/tscircuit/ic-pinouts.json (1 A0, 2 A1, 3 A2, 4 VSS, 5 SDA, 6 SCL, 7 WP, 8 VCC)

source_policy: Ball identity cross-checked against Lattice FPGA-SC-02034 Rev 3.0 (ECP5U-45 pinout, caBGA256 column) for all 256 balls and against the Raspberry Pi HAT+ specification. scripts/verify-bga-identity.ts enforces this file against the generated BGA footprint and fails if ball names were renumbered or reordered by an exporter.

ball_grid.naming_convention: JESD-95 style BGA ball naming; row letters I, O, Q and S are omitted (16 rows x 16 columns)
ball_grid.orientation: A1 is the top-left corner as seen from the component side; row A at the top, column 1 at the left
ball_grid.pad_numbering: row-major from the top-left corner; pin1 = A1, pin16 = A16, pin17 = B1, pin256 = T16

ball_audit.documented_scope: all 256 BG256 balls cross-checked against Lattice FPGA-SC-02034 Rev 3.0 (caBGA256 column)
ball_audit.identity_canonical_form: pad:ball:rowcol:pin_name:lattice_bank:signal:kind, one line per ball, LF-joined, UTF-8
ball_audit.gate: scripts/verify-bga-identity.ts fails on any grid, order, name or hash change and cross-checks a supplied FPGA-SC-02034 export ball-by-ball
